song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C Worthy of every song we could ever sing .G C Worthy of all the praise we could ever bring .G C Worthy of every breath we could ever breathe . G/B C We live for you__
[V2] .G C Jesus, the name above every other name .G/B C Jesus, the only One who could ever save .G C Worthy of every breath we could ever breathe . G C We live for you, Oh we live for You
[C1] . Cadd9 Am Holy, there is no one like You . G There is none beside You . Em7 Open up my eyes in wonder . Cadd9 Am Show me who You are and fill me . D With Your heart and lead me . Em7 In Your love to those around me
[B1] . C D Em I will build my life upon Your love . G/B It is a firm foundation . C D Em I will put my trust in You alone . G/B And I will not be shaken
song.title: Build My Life
song.author: Passion
